text.en:
In order that the President of the Philippines may continue the negotiations already started
between"the United States and the Philippines looking towards the adoption of the necessary measures to
adjust the economic and trade relations between the two countries on a basis mutually beneficial to both; there
is appropriated out of any funds in the Philippine Treasury not otherwise appropriated, the sum of one
hundred fifty thousand.pesos to defray, in the discretion of the President of the Philippines, the necessary
expenses that may be incurred in connection with the said negotiations.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, March 13, 1939.
